description.short_caption: Large firm mass protruding from the left hip.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a large, well-defined, firm mass protruding from the left hip region. The area has been prepped with an antiseptic solution, as evidenced by the orange discoloration of the skin. The mass appears smooth and dome-shaped, with no visible ulceration or discoloration of the overlying skin. The surrounding area is draped for a sterile procedure.

Case_17007/figure4.jpg.source_caption: Figure 3b. Contrast Enhanced Pelvic MRI – T2 weighted coronal view. Multi-loculated 7 x 17 x 11 cm mass arising from the gluteus maximus. Circumscribed by thin capsule/ pseudocapsule and containing numerous round foci measuring up to 1.2 cm.

description.short_caption: Pelvic MRI (T2-weighted coronal) showing a multi-loculated mass with round hyperintense foci.
description.detailed_description: This T2-weighted coronal MRI image of the pelvis demonstrates a large, multi-loculated mass arising from the gluteus maximus. The mass is well-circumscribed by a thin capsule or pseudocapsule and contains numerous round hyperintense foci, the largest measuring approximately 1.2 cm. The surrounding soft tissues appear intact without significant infiltration. The findings are suggestive of a lesion with cystic or necrotic components.
visible_findings: multi-loculated mass in the gluteal region
thin capsule or pseudocapsule surrounding the mass
numerous round hyperintense foci within the mass
no significant infiltration of surrounding soft tissues

Case_17007/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Ultrasound of gluteal cyst. Subcutaneous 16 x 8 x 17 cm coarsely echogenic lesion containing numerous round anechoic cysts measuring up to 1.2 cm.

description.short_caption: Ultrasound of left gluteal region showing a large lesion with multiple anechoic cystic structures.
description.detailed_description: This ultrasound image of the left gluteal region demonstrates a large, coarsely echogenic lesion measuring approximately 16.3 cm in length. The lesion contains numerous round anechoic cystic structures, each measuring up to 1.2 cm in diameter. The surrounding tissue appears heterogeneous, and the cystic structures are well-demarcated within the lesion. The image is labeled 'LONG LT GLUTEAL PALP,' indicating a longitudinal view of the left gluteal area.
visible_findings: Lesion measuring approximately 16.3 cm in length

Case_17007/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Figure 3a. Contrast Enhanced Pelvic MRI – T1 weighted axial view. Multi-loculated 7 x 17 x 11 cm mass arising from the gluteus maximus. Circumscribed by thin capsule/ pseudocapsule and containing numerous round foci measuring up to 1.2 cm.

description.short_caption: Axial T1-weighted MRI showing a multi-loculated mass in the gluteus maximus.
description.detailed_description: This axial T1-weighted contrast-enhanced MRI image depicts a large, multi-loculated mass measuring approximately 7 x 17 x 11 cm arising from the gluteus maximus muscle. The lesion is circumscribed by a thin capsule or pseudocapsule and contains numerous round foci, the largest measuring up to 1.2 cm. The mass is located on the right side of the pelvis, as indicated by the red arrow. Adjacent pelvic structures appear unremarkable.
visible_findings: multi-loculated mass in the gluteus maximus
thin capsule or pseudocapsule surrounding the lesion
numerous round foci within the mass

description.short_caption: Intra-operative photograph showing yellow necrotic material with transparent fluid-filled sacs.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph depicts material obtained during an intra-operative examination. The specimen consists of yellowish necrotic tissue interspersed with multiple transparent, fluid-filled sacs of varying sizes. The sacs appear to have a smooth surface and are distributed among the necrotic material. The background is a blue surgical drape, indicating the sterile field of the operating room.
